# BH Kitchen Remodeling Metro Detroit

> Kitchen remodeling for Metro Detroit homes across Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties: custom kitchen remodels, cabinet installation, countertop replacement, kitchen design, backsplash and tile, lighting, flooring, islands, appliance layout, and partial kitchen refreshes.

BH Kitchen Remodeling Metro Detroit serves Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties, including Detroit, Dearborn, Livonia, Westland, Troy, Rochester Hills, Southfield, Farmington Hills, Pontiac, Royal Oak, Warren, and Sterling Heights.
